# CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schema

Copied unchanged on 11 Nov 2026 from https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification (tag 1.6, `schema/`), published under the Apache License 2.0. Only `apps/host/test/sbom.test.ts` reads them, to check that Codehouse's SBOM (D-056) is a valid CycloneDX 1.6 document. Nothing in Codehouse itself loads them.
